description: Get the VDXF key ID from a URI string. Converts a human-readable VDXF URI (e.g., "vrsc::system.currency.export") into its on-chain i-address representation. Optionally combine with additional data (another VDXF key, a 256-bit hash, or an index number) to derive bound keys. Use this to resolve VDXF key names to i-addresses before querying getidentitycontent with a vdxfkey filter.

indexnum.description: Integer to combine with the key

uint256.description: 256-bit hex hash to combine with the key

vdxfkey.description: VDXF key or i-address to combine via hash

name: getvdxfid
